verdict.rationale: Viam's first-party materials explicitly claim OTA updates for software and ML models, plus canary testing and rollbacks for safe versioning. It also says models can be versioned, staged and rolled back 'just like code', and that Viam manages module versioning and deployment, with fragments for fleet configuration. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of staged-rollout mechanics (percentages, targeting by fragment or location, automated rollback triggers), hands-on or independent corroboration; the evidence is mostly marketing-level one-liners.
